request: DebugAI real defect evidence collection first-hop unit and review regression, offline isolated existing own worktree no model or production mutation

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
w="$p/.worktrees/hypothesis-review-evidence-20261028"
head=d8a9c2769f632b824e988023d2bec32b28c71923
[ "$(realpath "$p")" = "$p" ] && [ "$(realpath "$w")" = "$w" ] || exit 4
[ -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ] || { echo WORKTREE_DIRTY; exit 4; }
git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/debugai-scout-diagnosis-handoff-20261016
[ "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" ] || { echo SOURCE_MOVED; exit 4; }
git -C "$w" checkout --detach "$head" >/dev/null
image=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --memory 768m --cpus 1 --pids-limit 128 \
 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=1777 \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/server/workflow.js,target=/app/server/workflow.js,readonly" \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/server/tests/workflow-initial-test-dependency-evidence.test.cjs,target=/app/server/tests/workflow-initial-test-dependency-evidence.test.cjs,readonly" \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/compose.yaml,target=/app/compose.yaml,readonly" \
 --entrypoint node "$image" --test server/tests/workflow-initial-test-dependency-evidence.test.cjs server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs server/tests/workflow-six-role-horizontal-entry.test.cjs
echo DEBUGAI_TEST=PASS
echo DEBUGAI_SOURCE_HEAD="$head"
echo CREATED_NEW_TOP_LEVEL_SIBLING=NO
